privacy_strip.name: Privacy stripper
privacy_strip.desc: Removes location, device and time data from videos and photos before you share them.
privacy_strip.help: Give a file or a whole folder. Photos (JPEG, PNG) are cleaned losslessly; the rotation is kept so they are not shown sideways. Videos (MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, …) are copied without re-encoding, without GPS tracks, device names and timestamps. The original stays untouched; the result is saved next to it as <name>.clean.<ext>. Videos need ffmpeg (pkg install ffmpeg). Tip: in Termux, run termux-setup-storage once; your camera folder is then at ~/storage/dcim/Camera.
privacy_strip.nothing_found: No supported photos or videos found.
privacy_strip.already_clean: No metadata found, a clean copy was saved anyway.
